instructions: Successful search/scan/fetch writes a private trace. Retrieval is not usage or confirmation. Call record_source_use with selected (chosen for investigation), then validated (exact source checked and judged usable), then used (actually used in an answer or decision). record_outcome confirmed reinforces only saved graph paths of used sources. corrected/rolled_back names the confirmation receipt to reverse. Use a new idempotency_key for each operation; retry the same payload with the same key. memory_history lists traces or reads one trace. use_memory only orders graph candidates within the same hop; keyword scores/ranks never change. memory_unavailable means no usable trace was saved.

tools.name: memory_history
tools.description: Read your private, bounded trace history. trace_id returns source usage, current activation, saved paths, and outcome/reversal audit. Otherwise limit/cursor pages trace summaries.

tools.name: record_source_use
tools.description: Atomically record selected -> validated -> used for sources in your trace. selected = chosen for investigation; validated = exact source checked and usable; used = actually used in an answer/decision. Search alone is never used. Same key/payload returns the saved receipt; conflicting payload is rejected. Repeating a completed stage adds no activation.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: confirmed requires source_ids already used in this trace and strengthens only saved actual graph paths. One trace contributes to each edge once. corrected/rolled_back requires confirmation_id and reverses only that receipt contribution, preserving other traces. reason is saved for audit. Lexical sources have no graph credit. Idempotent by key/payload.
